description: Erection of single storey rear extension to the house following demolition of existing conservatory.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (03 (Rev B); 04 (Rev B);  05 (Rev B) Received:  18 January 2020;  Unreferenced Location Plan;  01;  02
Received:  13 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension hereby approved.
